as_told.title: Grey Fox/ISA and JSOC in UFO crash retrieval

plain: The claim is that crashed craft of unknown origin are recovered by elite US units: a CIA arm known as OGA, short for "Other Government Agency," and JSOC, the Joint Special Operations Command. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says this on the show. He bases it on "excellent reporting" by the journalist Chris Sharp and others, and says the CIA's OGA was created in 2002 and is used with JSOC "to perform crash retrievals and so forth." Michels makes a similar point in a later episode. He says the crash retrieval programme is "rumored to be closely coordinated" with JSOC and names a unit he calls Grey Fox, or ISA, as part of it, but he leaves out the CIA arm. If true, it would mean the recovery of such craft sits inside the country's most secret commando units.
